# Technical monetary verification artifacts

`actual-bridge.json` is the retained actual adapter/transport capture at app
`a9cae733944ce7e7c7e9bd0215feb4dd228bdc80`, SHA-256
`bbe458b362892bbfcc3b9c9a87db21a6e8ae0475aee3bd98f80d62b8e8660853`.
It contains engineering placeholders, not actual bank approval. The four gzip
assets, private completion proof and source manifests/files are stored by their
exact byte digest in `blobs/`. `closure-receipt.json` records source representation;
locked package metadata does not prove installed package execution.

`projection-receipt.json` separately binds the lossless schema generator, thirteen
frozen inputs, generated source and equality test. Their bytes are retained in
the same digest store; these are provenance inputs, not extra runtime reachability.

`actual-distinct-evidence.json`, SHA-256
`602d83e97a7629049ec49d7a4664d38b9b62384fd808d3e859d275d2255d3bc4`,
is a separate actual ledger A/B evidence-union control at preserved source head 8f1cc0da6e39d5b5ab50ec44bab8c121e0856b3c.
It is not another claimed adapter/transport execution.

The Fraction oracle was authored independently without reading app outputs.
Expected financial values are recomputed from policy/private input in tests;
the producer also independently verifies raw propagation, projections and refusals.
`technical-policy-declaration.txt` is explicitly an engineering description for
the separate connected source/controller protocol, never a historical bank source.

`connected-bridge.json`, SHA-256
`7d0e51fd3e702cfa87f8f3c2272fdd270865a8b5200ce6e8c950d770c7af9e92`,
executes the exact content-derived technical source subject used by the no-stub
controller regression. Its preapproval transport metadata is explicitly benchmark
bootstrap data, not an independent approval. The test independently creates review
records after actual benchmark verification and verifies revocation/removal.

That description-only capture remains unchanged as historical technical evidence.
The current connected admission regression uses `connected-material-bridge.json`
(SHA-256 `334b3682aab648d08cc7420f883b0dc812be3776094440dd16ec9f4e89bec656`).
It was executed by the same exact app a9cae733944ce7e7c7e9bd0215feb4dd228bdc80
against newly content-derived technical revisions for all 17 material fields.
The producer independently stages, reviews, publishes and revokes that same subject.
These fixtures demonstrate protocol mechanics, never bank policy acceptance.
